verdict.rationale: The docs list data-derived 'Insights into' transaction types, recurring transactions, consumer spending and loan payments, plus payment-success prediction and ownership-match confidence scores. None of these is described as AI-generated, and all are delivered as API outputs rather than as suggestions inside a user-facing product. The agent toolkit/MCP evidence covers developer documentation Q&A, not insights from the user's own data, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: explicit AI/ML-generated insights, in-product suggestions or recommendations surfaced to the user, documentation of how the insights are produced, independent or hands-on corroboration.
